Hobgoblin Drillmaster
Medium humanoid (goblinoid), lawful evil
Armor Class 18 (plate)
Hit Points 39 (6d8 + 12)
Speed 30 ft.
STR	DEX	CON	INT	WIS	CHA
15 (+2)	12 (+1)	14 (+2)	10 (+0)	11 (+0)	13 (+1)
Saving Throws Con +4, Wis +2
Skills Athletics +4, Intimidation +3
Condition Immunities frightened
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
Languages Common, Goblin
Challenge 2 (450 XP)
Proficiency Bonus +2
Martial Advantage. Once per turn, the drillmaster can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits.
Actions
Longsword. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
Legendary Actions
The drillmaster can take 1 legendary action.
